questions.questionText: Which is the internal energy reserve in plants?
questions.questionTextHi: पौधों में आंतरिक ऊर्जा भंडार क्या है?
questions.explanation:
The correct answer is **Starch**.

Key Points

	Starch is a **polysaccharide** that serves as a form of energy storage in plants.
	It is composed of numerous **glucose units** joined together by glycosidic bonds.
	Plants synthesize starch during photosynthesis and store it generally in plastids.
	Starch can be broken down into glucose molecules when the plant needs energy for growth and other metabolic activities.
	It is a **complex carbohydrate** that is insoluble in water, making it a good storage form of energy.

**Additional Information**

	**Glycogen**

	
		It is a polysaccharide of glucose that serves as a form of energy storage in animals and fungi.
		Glycogen is stored primarily in the liver and muscle cells.
	
	
	**Glucose**
	
		It is a simple sugar and a primary source of energy for cells.
		Glucose is involved in cellular respiration to produce ATP.
	
	
	**Sucrose**
	
		It is a disaccharide composed of glucose and fructose.
		Sucrose is commonly found in plants and is used for energy transport.

questions.questionText: If the mode of the following data is 7, then find the value of k.2, 4, 6, 7, 5, 6, 10, 6, 7, 2k + 1, 9, 7, 13
questions.explanation:
**Given:**

Mode of the data = 7

Data = {2, 4, 6, 7, 5, 6, 10, 6, 7, 2k + 1, 9, 7, 13}

**Formula used:**

Mode = The value that appears most frequently in the data.

**Calculation:**

The frequency of each value:

2 appears 1 time

4 appears 1 time

6 appears 3 times

7 appears 3 times

5, 10, 9, and 13 each appear 1 time

2k + 1 appears 1 time

Since mode = 7, the frequency of 7 must be higher than any other number.

Currently, frequency of 7 = 3

Frequency of 6 = 3

To make 7 the mode, the frequency of 7 must increase. This means 2k + 1 = 7.

⇒ 2k + 1 = 7

⇒ 2k = 7 - 1

⇒ 2k = 6

⇒ k = 3

**∴ The value of k is 3.**

आँकड़ों का बहुलक = 7

आँकड़े = {2, 4, 6, 7, 5, 6, 10, 6, 7, 2k + 1, 9, 7, 13}

**प्रयुक्त सूत्र:**

बहुलक = वह मान जो आँकड़ों में सबसे अधिक बार आता है।

**गणना:**

प्रत्येक मान की आवृत्ति:

7, 3 बार आता है

5, 10, 9 और 13 प्रत्येक 1 बार आते हैं

चूँकि बहुलक = 7 है, इसलिए 7 की आवृत्ति किसी अन्य संख्या से अधिक होनी चाहिए।

वर्तमान में, 7 की आवृत्ति = 3

6 की आवृत्ति = 3

7 को बहुलक बनाने के लिए, 7 की आवृत्ति बढ़नी चाहिए। इसका अर्थ है कि 2k + 1 = 7 है। 

⇒ 2k + 1 = 7

⇒ 2k = 7 - 1

⇒ 2k = 6

⇒ k = 3

**∴ k का मान 3 है।**

questions.questionText: Out of his total income, Sanjay spends 20% on house rent and 70% of the rest on household expenses. If he saves ₹1,800, then his total income is:
questions.questionTextHi: संजय अपनी कुल आय में से 20% घर के किराए पर और शेष का 70% घर के खर्चों पर व्यय करता है। यदि वह ₹1,800 बचाता है, तो उसकी कुल आय है:
questions.explanation:
**Given:**

Savings = ₹1,800

House rent = 20% of total income

Household expenses = 70% of the rest

**Formula Used:**

Total income = Savings / (1 - House rent% - Household expenses% of rest)

**Calculation:**

Let total income be ₹x.

House rent = 20% of ₹x = 0.20x

Remaining income after house rent = x - 0.20x = 0.80x

Household expenses = 70% of remaining income = 0.70 × 0.80x = 0.56x

Savings = Remaining income after household expenses = 0.80x - 0.56x = 0.24x

Given savings is ₹1,800

So, 0.24x = 1,800

⇒ x = 1,800 / 0.24

⇒ x = 7,500

**The total income is ₹7,500.**
questions.explanationHi:
**दिया गया है:**

बचत = ₹1,800

मकान किराया = कुल आय का 20%

घरेलू खर्च = शेष का 70%

**प्रयुक्त सूत्र:**

कुल आय = बचत / (1 - मकान किराया % - शेष का घरेलू खर्च %)

**गणना:**

माना, कुल आय ₹x है।

मकान किराया = ₹x का 20% = 0.20x

मकान किराये के बाद शेष आय = x - 0.20x = 0.80x

घरेलू खर्च = शेष आय का 70% = 0.70 × 0.80x = 0.56x

बचत = घरेलू खर्च के बाद बची हुई आय = 0.80x - 0.56x = 0.24x

दी गई बचत ₹1,800 है। 

अतः, 0.24x = 1,800

⇒ x = 1,800 / 0.24

⇒ x = 7,500

**कुल आय ₹7,500 है।**

questions.questionText: For preparation of which of the following compounds is the chlor-alkali process used?
questions.questionTextHi: निम्नलिखित में से किस यौगिक के निर्माण के लिए क्लोर-क्षार प्रक्रिया का उपयोग किया जाता है?
questions.explanation:
The correct answer is **NaOH + Cl₂**.

Key Points

	The chlor-alkali process is used for the industrial production of sodium hydroxide (NaOH) and chlorine gas (Cl₂).
	In this process, electrolysis of brine (a concentrated solution of NaCl) occurs.
	Sodium hydroxide is produced at the cathode, while chlorine gas is produced at the anode.
	The process also produces hydrogen gas as a by-product at the cathode.
	The chlor-alkali process is a major industrial process and is essential for producing various chemical products.

**Additional Information**

	**NaHCO₃ (Sodium Bicarbonate)**

	
		Commonly known as baking soda, it is used in baking, cleaning, and as an antacid.
		It is produced through the Solvay process.
	
	
	**Na₂CO₃ (Sodium Carbonate)**
	
		Also known as soda ash, it is used in glass manufacturing, as a water softener, and in detergents.
		It can be produced by the Solvay process or mining of trona ore.
	
	
	**NaCl (Sodium Chloride)**
	
		Commonly known as table salt, it is essential for human consumption and various industrial applications.
		It is obtained by mining or evaporation of seawater.

सही उत्तर **NaOH + Cl₂** है।

	इस प्रक्रिया में, ब्राइन (NaCl का सांद्र विलयन) का वैद्युत अपघटन होता है।

	यह प्रक्रिया कैथोड पर उपोत्पाद के रूप में हाइड्रोजन गैस भी उत्पन्न करती है।
	क्लोर-क्षार प्रक्रिया एक प्रमुख औद्योगिक प्रक्रिया है और विभिन्न रासायनिक उत्पादों के उत्पादन के लिए आवश्यक है।

questions.questionText: The work done by a constant force of 5 Newton acting on a body is 5 joules. The displacement of the body in the direction of the applied force is _____.
questions.questionTextHi: 5 न्यूटन के एक नियत बल द्वारा किसी पिंड पर किया गया कार्य 5 जूल है। आरोपित बल की दिशा में पिंड का विस्थापन _____ है।
questions.explanation:
The correct answer is **1 m**.

Key Points

	The work done by a force is calculated using the formula: **Work = Force × Displacement**.
	Given the work done is 5 joules and the force applied is 5 Newtons.
	Rearranging the formula to find displacement: **Displacement = Work / Force**.
	Substituting the given values: **Displacement = 5 J / 5 N = 1 m**.
	Hence, the displacement in the direction of the applied force is **1 meter**.

**Additional Information**

	**Work-Energy Theorem**

	
		This theorem states that the work done by the net force on an object is equal to the change in its kinetic energy.
		Mathematically, it is expressed as Work = ΔK.E.
	
	
	**Units of Work**
	
		The SI unit of work is the joule (J).
		1 joule is defined as the work done when a force of 1 Newton displaces an object by 1 meter in the direction of the force.
	
	
	**Types of Forces**
	
		Forces can be categorized into various types such as gravitational force, normal force, frictional force, and applied force.
		In this context, the force mentioned is an applied force of 5 Newtons acting on the body.
questions.explanationHi:
सही उत्तर **1 m** है।

Key Points

	बल द्वारा किया गया कार्य इस सूत्र का उपयोग करके गणना किया जाता है: **कार्य = बल × विस्थापन**
	दिया गया है कि किया गया कार्य 5 जूल है और लगाया गया बल 5 न्यूटन है।

	इसलिए, प्रयुक्त बल की दिशा में विस्थापन **1 मीटर** है।

	**बल के प्रकार**

Prime factorization:

56 = 23 × 71

LCM = 8 × 3 × 7

⇒ LCM = 168

**The LCM of 24, 42, and 56 is 168.**

questions.questionText: Magnification produced by a convex mirror for a given object of height 5 cm is 0.2. Here, the height of the image is _____.
questions.questionTextHi: 5 cm ऊँचाई वाली किसी वस्तु के लिए उत्तल दर्पण द्वारा उत्पन्न आवर्धन 0.2 है। यहाँ, प्रतिबिंब की ऊँचाई _____ है।
questions.explanation:
The correct answer is **1 cm**.

Key Points

	Magnification (m) produced by a mirror is given by the ratio of the height of the image (hi) to the height of the object (ho).
	Mathematically, magnification (m) = hi / ho.
	Given magnification (m) = 0.2 and height of the object (ho) = 5 cm.
	Substituting the values into the magnification formula: 0.2 = hi / 5 cm.
	Solving for hi, we get hi = 0.2 * 5 cm = 1 cm.

**Additional Information**

	**Concave Mirror**

	
		Produces real and inverted images when the object is placed beyond the focal point.
		Produces virtual and magnified images when the object is placed between the focal point and the mirror.
	
	
	**Plane Mirror**
	
		Always produces a virtual, erect, and laterally inverted image.
		The size of the image is equal to the size of the object.
questions.explanationHi:
सही उत्तर **1 cm** है।

Key Points

	एक दर्पण द्वारा उत्पन्न आवर्धन (m) प्रतिबिंब की ऊँचाई (hi) और वस्तु की ऊँचाई (ho) के अनुपात द्वारा दिया जाता है।
	गणितीय रूप से, आवर्धन (m) = hi / ho
	दिया गया आवर्धन (m) = 0.2 और वस्तु की ऊँचाई (ho) = 5 cm
	आवर्धन सूत्र में मानों को प्रतिस्थापित करने पर: 0.2 = hi / cm
	hi के लिए हल करने पर, हमें hi = 0.2 * 5 cm = 1 cm प्राप्त होता है।

**Additional Information**

	**अवतल दर्पण**

	
		जब वस्तु फोकस बिंदु से परे रखी जाती है, तो वास्तविक और उल्टे प्रतिबिंब उत्पन्न करता है।
		जब वस्तु फोकस बिंदु और दर्पण के बीच रखी जाती है, तो आभासी और आवर्धित प्रतिबिंब उत्पन्न करता है।
	
	
	**समतल दर्पण**

questions.questionText: The equivalent resistance of the two resistors of resistance R ohm each connected in series is ________
questions.questionTextHi: प्रत्येक R ओम प्रतिरोध के दो प्रतिरोधकों को श्रेणीक्रम में जोड़ने पर तुल्य प्रतिरोध ________ होता है।
questions.explanation:
The correct answer is **2R ohm**.

Key Points

	When resistors are connected in series, their resistances add up.
	The total or equivalent resistance (Req) in a series circuit is given by the formula Req = R1 + R2 + ... + Rn.
	For two resistors of resistance R ohm each connected in series, the equivalent resistance is R + R.
	Thus, the equivalent resistance is 2R ohm.
	This is why the correct answer is option 3, which states 2R ohm.

**Additional Information**

	**Resistors in Parallel**

	
		When resistors are connected in parallel, the total resistance decreases.
		The formula for the equivalent resistance in a parallel circuit is 1/Req = 1/R1 + 1/R2 + ... + 1/Rn.
	
	
	**Ohm's Law**
	
		Ohm's Law states that the current through a conductor between two points is directly proportional to the voltage across the two points.
		The formula is V = IR, where V is the voltage, I is the current, and R is the resistance.
	
	
	**Combining Series and Parallel Circuits**
	
		In complex circuits, series and parallel connections can be combined.
		The approach involves simplifying the circuit step by step, first solving series and parallel parts separately.
questions.explanationHi:
सही उत्तर **2R ओम** है।

Key Points

	जब प्रतिरोधक श्रेणीक्रम में जुड़े होते हैं, तो उनके प्रतिरोध जुड़ जाते हैं।
	श्रेणीक्रम परिपथ में कुल या समतुल्य प्रतिरोध (Req) सूत्र Req = R1 + R2 + ... + Rn द्वारा दिया जाता है।
	प्रत्येक R ओम प्रतिरोध के दो प्रतिरोधक श्रेणीक्रम में जुड़े होने पर, समतुल्य प्रतिरोध R + R होता है।
	इस प्रकार, समतुल्य प्रतिरोध 2R ओम है।
	यही कारण है कि सही उत्तर विकल्प 3 है, जिसमें 2R ओम बताया गया है।

**Additional Information**

	**पार्श्व क्रम में प्रतिरोधक**

	
		जब प्रतिरोधक पार्श्व क्रम में जुड़े होते हैं, तो कुल प्रतिरोध कम हो जाता है।
		पार्श्व क्रम परिपथ में समतुल्य प्रतिरोध का सूत्र 1/Req = 1/R1 + 1/R2 + ... + 1/Rn है।
	
	
	**ओम का नियम**
	
		ओम का नियम कहता है कि दो बिंदुओं के बीच एक चालक के माध्यम से धारा, दो बिंदुओं के बीच वोल्टता के समानुपाती होती है।
		सूत्र V = IR है, जहाँ V वोल्टता है, I धारा है, और R प्रतिरोध है।
	
	
	**श्रेणीक्रम और पार्श्व क्रम**** परिपथों का संयोजन**
	
		जटिल परिपथों में, श्रेणीक्रम और पार्श्व क्रम संयोजन को जोड़ा जा सकता है।
		इस विधि में चरण दर चरण परिपथ को सरल करना शामिल है, पहले श्रेणीक्रम और पार्श्व क्रम भागों को अलग से हल करना।

	Electromagnets are devices that produce a magnetic field when an electric current passes through them.
	They do not convert magnetic fields into electrical energy.
	Electromagnets do not convert mechanical energy into magnetic energy; they convert electrical energy into magnetic energy.
	Statement I is incorrect because the function of an electromagnet is to create a magnetic field using electrical energy.
	Statement II is also incorrect because electromagnets do not deal with mechanical energy directly.

		They operate based on electromagnetic induction principles.
	
	
	**Transformers**

		They work based on the principle of mutual induction between two or more windings.

questions.questionText: Jaggu can make one wooden chair in 3 days and Rabbu can make the same chair in 4 days. If they work together, in how many days will they make 14 chairs of the same kind?
questions.questionTextHi: जग्गू एक लकड़ी की कुर्सी 3 दिनों में बना सकता है और रब्बू उसी कुर्सी को 4 दिनों में बना सकता है। यदि वे एक साथ कार्य करते हैं, तो वे उसी प्रकार की 14 कुर्सियाँ कितने दिनों में बनाएँगे?
questions.explanation:
**Given:**

Jaggu can make one wooden chair in 3 days.

Rabbu can make one wooden chair in 4 days.

**Formula Used:**

Work rate = Work / Time

Combined Work Rate = Sum of individual work rates

Total Time = Total Work / Combined Work Rate

**Calculation:**

Jaggu's work rate = 1 chair / 3 days = 1/3 chair per day

Rabbu's work rate = 1 chair / 4 days = 1/4 chair per day

Combined work rate = (1/3 + 1/4) chair per day

⇒ Combined work rate = (4/12 + 3/12) chair per day

⇒ Combined work rate = 7/12 chair per day

Total work = 14 chairs

Total time = 14 chairs / (7/12) chair per day

⇒ Total time = 14 × 12/7

⇒ Total time = 14 × 12 / 7

⇒ Total time = 24 days

**Jaggu and Rabbu will make 14 chairs in 24 days.**

****Alternate Method** **Total work = LCM(3 , 4) = 12 units

Efficiency of Jaggu = 12/3 = 4 chairs per day

Efficiency of Rabbu = 12/4 = 3 chairs per day

Total efficiency of Jaggu and Rabbu = 4 + 3 = 7

Number of days taken by Rabbu and Jaggu for completing 12 chairs = 12/7 days

Number of days taken by Rabbu and Jaggu for completing 14 chairs = 12/7 × 14 = 24 days

Jaggu and Rabbu will make 14 chairs in 24 days.
questions.explanationHi:
**दिया गया है:**

जग्गू एक लकड़ी की कुर्सी 3 दिनों में बना सकता है।

रब्बू एक लकड़ी की कुर्सी 4 दिनों में बना सकता है।

**प्रयुक्त सूत्र:**

कार्य दर = कार्य / समय

संयुक्त कार्य दर = व्यक्तिगत कार्य दरों का योग

कुल समय = कुल कार्य / संयुक्त कार्य दर

**गणना:**

जग्गू की कार्य दर = 1 कुर्सी / 3 दिन = 1/3 कुर्सी प्रति दिन

रब्बू की कार्य दर = 1 कुर्सी / 4 दिन = 1/4 कुर्सी प्रति दिन

संयुक्त कार्य दर = (1/3 + 1/4) कुर्सी प्रति दिन

⇒ संयुक्त कार्य दर = (4/12 + 3/12) कुर्सी प्रति दिन

⇒ संयुक्त कार्य दर = 7/12 कुर्सी प्रति दिन

कुल कार्य = 14 कुर्सियाँ

कुल समय = 14 कुर्सियाँ / (7/12) कुर्सी प्रति दिन

⇒ कुल समय = 14 × 12/7

⇒ कुल समय = 14 × 12 / 7

⇒ कुल समय = 24 दिन

**जग्गू और रब्बू 24 दिनों में 14 कुर्सियाँ बनाएँगे।**

**Alternate Method**** **कुल कार्य = LCM(3 , 4) = 12 इकाइयाँ

जग्गू की दक्षता = 12/3 = 4 कुर्सियाँ प्रति दिन

रब्बू की दक्षता = 12/4 = 3 कुर्सियाँ प्रति दिन

जग्गू और रब्बू की कुल दक्षता = 4 + 3 = 7

रब्बू और जग्गू द्वारा 12 कुर्सियाँ पूरी करने में लगा समय = 12/7 दिन

रब्बू और जग्गू द्वारा 14 कुर्सियाँ पूरी करने में लगा समय = 12/7 × 14 = 24 दिन

जग्गू और रब्बू 24 दिनों में 14 कुर्सियाँ बनाएँगे।

questions.questionText: If a regular polygon has 20 diagonals, then the number of sides of this polygon is:
questions.questionTextHi: यदि एक सम बहुभुज में 20 विकर्ण हैं, तो इस बहुभुज की भुजाओं की संख्या है:
questions.explanation:
**Given:**

If a regular polygon has 20 diagonals, then the number of sides of this polygon is:

**Formula Used:**

Number of diagonals in a polygon = \(\frac{n(n-3)}{2}\)

**Calculation:**

Given the number of diagonals = 20

Let the number of sides be n

Using the formula:

\( \frac{n(n-3)}{2} = 20 \)

Multiply both sides by 2:

\( n(n-3) = 40 \)

Solve the quadratic equation:

\( n^2 - 3n - 40 = 0 \)

Factorize the quadratic equation:

\( (n - 8)(n + 5) = 0 \)

So, n = 8 or n = -5

Since the number of sides cannot be negative, n = 8

**The number of sides of the polygon is 8.**
questions.explanationHi:
**दिया गया है:**

यदि एक सम बहुभुज में 20 विकर्ण हैं, तो इस बहुभुज की भुजाओं की संख्या ज्ञात कीजिए।

**प्रयुक्त सूत्र:**

एक बहुभुज में विकर्णों की संख्या = \(\frac{n(n-3)}{2}\)

**गणना:**

दिया गया है कि विकर्णों की संख्या = 20

माना, भुजाओं की संख्या n है। 

सूत्र का उपयोग करने पर:

\( \frac{n(n-3)}{2} = 20 \)

दोनों ओर 2 से गुणा कीजिए:

\( n(n-3) = 40 \)

द्विघात समीकरण को हल कीजिए:

\( n^2 - 3n - 40 = 0 \)

द्विघात समीकरण के गुणनखंड कीजिए:

\( (n - 8)(n + 5) = 0 \)

इसलिए, n = 8 या n = -5

चूँकि भुजाओं की संख्या ऋणात्मक नहीं हो सकती है, इसलिए n = 8

**बहुभुज की भुजाओं की संख्या 8 है।**

questions.explanation:
The correct answer is **option 3**.

Key Points

	A suspension is a heterogeneous mixture, meaning its components are not uniformly distributed.
	The particles in a suspension are large enough to be seen with the naked eye.
	Suspensions are unstable; the particles can settle upon standing.
	The particles of a suspension scatter a beam of light passing through it, a phenomenon known as the Tyndall effect.
	The correct answer states that the particles of a suspension cannot be seen by the naked eyes, which is incorrect as they can be seen.

**Additional Information**

	**Colloids**

	
		Colloids are mixtures where the particle size is intermediate between that of a solution and a suspension.
		Particles in a colloid are not visible to the naked eye but can scatter light (Tyndall effect).
	
	
	**Solutions**
	
		Solutions are homogeneous mixtures where the solute is completely dissolved in the solvent.
		The particles in a solution are at the molecular or ionic level and do not scatter light.
	
	
	**Emulsions**
	
		Emulsions are a type of colloid where two immiscible liquids are mixed together.
		Common examples include milk and mayonnaise.

यदि + का अर्थ - है, - का अर्थ × है, × का अर्थ ÷ है और ÷ का अर्थ + है, तो निम्नलिखित समीकरण में प्रश्न चिह्न (?) के स्थान पर क्या आएगा?

questions.explanation:
**Given: 22 - 5 ÷ 3 + 12 × 3 = ?**

			 Symbol

			 - 
			 × 
			 ÷ 
		 
	 
	 
		 
			 Means 
			 **-** 
			 **×** 
			 **÷** 
			 **+** 
		 
	 
 

 

Now replacing the sign from left to right using BODMAS Rule, we get:

⇒ 22 × 5 + 3 - 12 ÷ 3**

= 22 × 5 + 1 - 4**

⇒ 22 × 5 + 1 - 4

= 22 × 5 + (-3)

= 110 - 3

= **109**

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 2".**

questions.explanation:
The correct answer is **Double displacement reaction**.

Key Points

	In a **double displacement reaction**, the ions of two compounds exchange places in an aqueous solution to form two new compounds.
	This type of reaction generally occurs between two ionic compounds.
	The general formula for a double displacement reaction is AB + CD → AD + CB.
	These reactions are often characterized by the formation of a precipitate, a gas, or water.
	Double displacement reactions are also known as metathesis reactions.

**Additional Information**

	**Decomposition Reaction**

	
		In this reaction, a single compound breaks down into two or more simpler substances.
		It can be represented as AB → A + B.
	
	
	**Addition Reaction**
	
		Involves two or more substances combining to form a single product.
		This type of reaction is common in organic chemistry.
	
	
	**Disproportionation Reaction**
	
		It is a specific type of redox reaction in which a single substance is simultaneously oxidized and reduced.
		An example is the conversion of hydrogen peroxide into water and oxygen.

Key Points

	The endocrine system consists of glands that secrete hormones directly into the bloodstream.
	These hormones regulate various bodily functions such as metabolism, growth, and mood.
	Major glands in the endocrine system include the pituitary, thyroid, adrenal, and pancreas.
	Hormones are chemical messengers that travel to target organs and tissues to exert their effects.
	The endocrine system works in conjunction with the nervous system to maintain homeostasis in the body.

**Additional Information**

	**Excretory system**

	
		Responsible for removing waste products from the body.

	**Respiratory system**
	
		Responsible for the exchange of gases (oxygen and carbon dioxide) between the body and the environment.
		Includes organs such as the lungs, trachea, and bronchi.
	
	
	**Digestive system**
	
		Breaks down food into nutrients that the body can absorb and use for energy.

questions.questionText: A car can cover 275 km in 5 hours. If its speed is reduced by 5 km/hr, then how much time will the car take to cover a distance of 250 km?
questions.questionTextHi: एक कार 275 किलोमीटर की दूरी 5 घंटे में तय करती है। यदि इसकी चाल 5 किलोमीटर/घंटा कम कर दी जाए, तो कार 250 किमी की दूरी तय करने में कितना समय लेगी?
questions.explanation:
**Given:**

Initial speed of the car = 275 km / 5 hr = 55 km/hr

Reduced speed of the car = 55 km/hr - 5 km/hr = 50 km/hr

Distance to be covered = 250 km

**Formula Used:**

Time = Distance / Speed

**Calculation:**

Time taken to cover 250 km at 50 km/hr:

Time = Distance / Speed

⇒ Time = 250 km / 50 km/hr

⇒ Time = 5 hours

**The car will take 5 hours to cover a distance of 250 km.**
questions.explanationHi:
**दिया गया है:**

कार की प्रारंभिक चाल = 275 किमी / 5 घंटे = 55 किमी/घंटा

कार की कम हुई चाल = 55 किमी/घंटा - 5 किमी/घंटा = 50 किमी/घंटा

तय की जाने वाली दूरी = 250 किमी

**प्रयुक्त सूत्र:**

समय = दूरी / चाल

**गणना:**

50 किमी/घंटा की चाल से 250 किमी की दूरी तय करने में लगा समय:

समय = दूरी / चाल

⇒ समय = 250 किमी / 50 किमी/घंटा

⇒ समय = 5 घंटे

**कार 250 किमी की दूरी तय करने में 5 घंटे का समय लेगी।**

questions.questionText: A diver rowing at the speed of 3 km/h in still water takes double the time going 50 km upstream compared to going 50 km downstream. The speed of the diver against the stream is
questions.questionTextHi: एक गोताखोर स्थिर जल में 3 किलोमीटर/घंटा की चाल से नाव चलाता है और 50 किलोमीटर धारा के प्रतिकूल जाने में, 50 किलोमीटर धारा के अनुकूल जाने की तुलना में दोगुना समय लेता है। धारा के प्रतिकूल गोताखोर की चाल है:
questions.explanation:
Shortcut Trick
Since the distance (50 km) is constant, the speed of the diver is inversely proportional to the time taken.

Time ratio (Upstream : Downstream) = 2 : 1 ⇒ Speed ratio (Upstream : Downstream) = 1 : 2

Speed in still water = (Upstream Speed + Downstream Speed) ÷ 2 = (1 + 2) ÷ 2 = 1.5 ratio units.

We are given that still water speed is 3 km/h ⇒ 1.5 ratio units = 3 km/h.

⇒ 1 ratio unit = 2 km/h. Since the upstream speed corresponds to 1 ratio unit, it directly equals 2 km/h.

**∴ The correct answer is 2 km/h.**

**Alternate Method**

**Given:**

Speed of diver in still water (v) = 3 km/h

Distance traveled upstream and downstream = 50 km

Time taken upstream = 2 × Time taken downstream

**Formula Used:**

Time = Distance ÷ Speed

Upstream Speed = v − s | Downstream Speed = v + s

**Calculations:**

Let the speed of the stream be s km/h.

⇒ Upstream speed (U) = (3 − s) km/h

⇒ Downstream speed (D) = (3 + s) km/h

According to the given condition in the question:

⇒ 50 ÷ (3 − s) = 2 × [50 ÷ (3 + s)]

Canceling 50 from both sides:

⇒ 1 ÷ (3 − s) = 2 ÷ (3 + s)

By cross-multiplying:

⇒ 3 + s = 2 × (3 − s)

⇒ 3 + s = 6 − 2s

⇒ s + 2s = 6 − 3

⇒ 3s = 3

⇒ s = 1 km/h

The speed of the diver against the stream (Upstream Speed):

⇒ U = 3 − s

⇒ U = 3 − 1 = 2 km/h.

**∴ The correct answer is 2 km/h.**

**Additional Information**

Speed in Still Water

It is the average of the downstream and upstream speeds. Formula: v = (D + U) ÷ 2, where D is downstream speed and U is upstream speed.

Speed of Stream

It is half the difference between the downstream and upstream speeds. Formula: s = (D − U) ÷ 2.

Constant Distance Relation

Whenever the distance traveled is constant, the ratio of speeds is always inversely proportional to the ratio of their respective times taken. (Speed ∝ 1 ÷ Time).

94:Tb64,**दिया गया है:**

स्थिर जल में गोताखोर की चाल (u) = 3 किलोमीटर/घंटा

धारा के प्रतिकूल दूरी = धारा के अनुकूल दूरी = 50 किलोमीटर

धारा के प्रतिकूल लिया गया समय = धारा के अनुकूल लिए गए समय का 2 गुना

**प्रयुक्त सूत्र:**

समय = दूरी / चाल

धारा के प्रतिकूल गोताखोर की चाल = u - v

धारा के अनुकूल गोताखोर की चाल = u + v

**गणना:**

मान लीजिए धारा की चाल v किलोमीटर/घंटा है।

धारा के प्रतिकूल लिया गया समय = 50 / (3 - v)

धारा के अनुकूल लिया गया समय = 50 / (3 + v)

दिया गया है: धारा के प्रतिकूल समय = धारा के अनुकूल समय का 2 गुना

⇒ 50 / (3 - v) = 2 × (50 / (3 + v))

⇒ 1 / (3 - v) = 2 / (3 + v)

⇒ (3 + v) = 2 × (3 - v)

⇒ 3 + v = 6 - 2v

⇒ 3v = 3

⇒ v = 1 किलोमीटर/घंटा

धारा के प्रतिकूल गोताखोर की चाल = धारा के प्रतिकूल चाल = u - v = 3 - 1 = 2 किलोमीटर/घंटा

**∴ धारा के प्रतिकूल की चाल 2 किलोमीटर/घंटा है।**

Key Points

	Evaporation is the process by which water changes from a liquid to a gas or vapor.
	An increase in temperature generally increases the rate of evaporation because the molecules move faster and are more likely to escape into the air.
	An increase in surface area allows more molecules to evaporate at once, thus increasing the rate of evaporation.
	An increase in wind speed removes the air saturated with water vapor from the vicinity, allowing more water to evaporate.
	A decrease in humidity means the air can hold more water vapor, thus increasing the rate of evaporation.

**Additional Information**

	**Condensation**

	
		Condensation is the process by which water vapor in the air is changed into liquid water.
		It is the opposite of evaporation and occurs when the air is cooled to its dew point.
	
	
	**Boiling**
	
		Boiling is the rapid vaporization of a liquid, which occurs when a liquid is heated to its boiling point.
		At this temperature, the vapor pressure of the liquid is equal to the external pressure exerted on the liquid.
	
	
	**Sublimation**
	
		Sublimation is the transition of a substance directly from the solid to the gas phase without passing through the liquid phase.
		This occurs under specific conditions of pressure and temperature.

**Given:**

Single discount = 84%

Two successive discounts = ?

**Formula used:**

Effective discount = d1 + d2 - (d1 × d2) / 100

Where d1 and d2 are the two successive discounts.

**Calculation:**

We check the options:

Option 1: d1 = 30%, d2 = 70%

Effective discount = 30 + 70 - (30 × 70) / 100

⇒ 100 - 21 = 79%

(Not 84%)

Option 2: d1 = 20%, d2 = 80%

Effective discount = 20 + 80 - (20 × 80) / 100

⇒ 100 - 16 = 84%

(Correct!)

Option 3: d1 = 10%, d2 = 90%

Effective discount = 10 + 90 - (10 × 90) / 100

⇒ 100 - 9 = 91%

(Not 84%)

Option 4: d1 = 40%, d2 = 60%

Effective discount = 40 + 60 - (40 × 60) / 100

⇒ 100 - 24 = 76%

(Not 84%)

**∴ The correct option is 20% and 80%.**

questions.questionText: The sum of a two-digit number and the number obtained by reversing the digits is 99. If the digits of the number differ by 5, then the two-digit number can be:
questions.questionTextHi: दो अंकों वाली एक संख्या और उसके अंकों को उलटने पर प्राप्त संख्या का योग 99 है। यदि संख्या के अंक 5 से भिन्न हैं, तो दो अंकों वाली संख्या हो सकती है:
questions.explanation:
**Given:**

Let the two-digit number be 10x + y, where x is the tens digit and y is the units digit.

The number obtained by reversing the digits = 10y + x.

Sum of the two numbers = 99

Digits differ by 5, i.e., |x - y| = 5

Calculation:

10x + y + 10y + x = 99

|x - y| = 5

From the first equation:

⇒ 10x + y + 10y + x = 99

⇒ 11x + 11y = 99

⇒ x + y = 9

From the second condition:

|x - y| = 5

Case 1: x - y = 5

⇒ x + y = 9 and x - y = 5

Add the equations:

⇒ 2x = 14

⇒ x = 7

⇒ y = 9 - 7 = 2

⇒ The number = 10x + y = 10(7) + 2 = 72

Case 2: y - x = 5

⇒ x + y = 9 and y - x = 5

Add the equations:

⇒ 2y = 14

⇒ y = 7

⇒ x = 9 - 7 = 2

⇒ The number = 10x + y = 10(2) + 7 = 27

The two-digit number can be 72 or 27.

**Since only 27 is given in the option. So 27 is the correct option.**
questions.explanationHi:
**दिया गया है:**

मान लीजिए कि दो अंकों वाली संख्या 10x + y है, जहाँ x दहाई का अंक है और y इकाई का अंक है।

अंकों को उलटने पर प्राप्त संख्या = 10y + x

दोनों संख्याओं का योग = 99

अंक 5 से भिन्न हैं, अर्थात, |x - y| = 5

गणना:

10x + y + 10y + x = 99

|x - y| = 5

पहले समीकरण से:

⇒ 10x + y + 10y + x = 99

⇒ 11x + 11y = 99

⇒ x + y = 9

दूसरी शर्त से:

|x - y| = 5

स्थिति 1: x - y = 5

⇒ x + y = 9 और x - y = 5

समीकरणों को जोड़ने पर:

⇒ 2x = 14

⇒ x = 7

⇒ y = 9 - 7 = 2

⇒ संख्या = 10x + y = 10(7) + 2 = 72

स्थिति 2: y - x = 5

⇒ x + y = 9 और y - x = 5

समीकरणों को जोड़ने पर:

⇒ 2y = 14

⇒ y = 7

⇒ x = 9 - 7 = 2

⇒ संख्या = 10x + y = 10(2) + 7 = 27

दो अंकों वाली संख्या 72 या 27 हो सकती है।

**चूँकि विकल्प में केवल 27 दिया गया है। इसलिए 27 सही उत्तर है।**

questions.questionText: A solid metallic sphere of radius 12 cm is melted and recast in the form of small spheres of radius 2 cm. How many small spheres are formed?
questions.questionTextHi: 12 सेमी त्रिज्या वाले एक ठोस धात्विक गोले को पिघलाकर 2 सेमी त्रिज्या वाले छोटे गोलों के रूप में ढाला जाता है। कितने छोटे गोले बनते हैं?
questions.explanation:
**Given:**

Radius of the solid metallic sphere = 12 cm

Radius of the small spheres = 2 cm

**Formula Used:**

Volume of a sphere = \(\frac{4}{3}\pi r^3\)

**Calculation:**

Volume of the solid metallic sphere = \(\frac{4}{3}\pi (12)^3\)

Volume of one small sphere = \(\frac{4}{3}\pi (2)^3\)

Number of small spheres formed = Volume of the solid metallic sphere / Volume of one small sphere

⇒ Number of small spheres = \(\frac{\frac{4}{3}\pi (12)^3}{\frac{4}{3}\pi (2)^3} \)

⇒ Number of small spheres = \(\frac{(12)3}{(2)^3}\)

⇒ Number of small spheres = \(\frac{1728}{8}\)

⇒ Number of small spheres = 216

**Therefore, the number of small spheres formed is 216.**
questions.explanationHi:
**दिया गया है:**

ठोस धात्विक गोले की त्रिज्या = 12 सेमी

छोटे गोलों की त्रिज्या = 2 सेमी

**प्रयुक्त सूत्र:**

गोले का आयतन = \(\frac{4}{3}\pi r^3\)

**गणना:**

ठोस धात्विक गोले का आयतन = \(\frac{4}{3}\pi (12)^3\)

एक छोटे गोले का आयतन = \(\frac{4}{3}\pi (2)^3\)

बने छोटे गोलों की संख्या = ठोस धात्विक गोले का आयतन / एक छोटे गोले का आयतन

⇒ छोटे गोलों की संख्या = \(\frac{\frac{4}{3}\pi (12)^3}{\frac{4}{3}\pi (2)^3} \)

⇒ छोटे गोलों की संख्या = \(\frac{(12)^3}{(2)^3}\)

⇒ छोटे गोलों की संख्या = \(\frac{1728}{8}\)

⇒ छोटे गोलों की संख्या = 216

**इसलिए, बने छोटे गोलों की संख्या 216 है।**

questions.questionText:
In a certain code language,

A + B means ‘A is the mother of B’,

A – B means ‘A is the brother of B’,

A × B means ‘A is the wife of B’,

A ÷ B means ‘A is the father of B’

And A # B means ‘A is the daughter of B’.

How is K related to Q if ‘P × Q ÷ T + Z – S # K’?
questions.questionTextHi:
एक निश्चित कूट भाषा में,

A + B का अर्थ है 'A, B की माता है',

A – B का अर्थ है 'A, B का भाई है',

A × B का अर्थ है 'A, B की पत्नी है',

A ÷ B का अर्थ है 'A, B का पिता है'

और A # B का अर्थ है 'A, B की पुत्री है'.

यदि 'P × Q ÷ T + Z – S # K' है तो K, Q से किस प्रकार संबंधित है?
questions.explanation:
Family Chart:

Decoding the Symbols:

 
	 
		 
			 Symbol 
			 + 
			 - 
			 × 
			 ÷ 
			 # 
		 
		 
			 Meaning 
			 Mother 
			 Brother 
			 Wife 
			 Father 
			 Daughter 
		 
	 
 

 

Given: P × Q ÷ T + Z – S # K

It means: P is the wife of Q, Q is the father of T, T is the mother of Z, Z is the brother of S and S is the daughter of K. 

So, K is the **Daughter's husband** of Q.

Hence, the correct answer is "Daughter's husband".
questions.explanationHi:
वंश-वृक्ष आलेख:

प्रतीकों को विकूटित करने पर:

 
	 
		 
			 प्रतीक  
			 + 
			 - 
			 × 
			 ÷ 
			 # 
		 
		 
			 अर्थ  
			 माता  
			 भाई  
			 पत्नी  
			 पिता  
			 पुत्री  
		 
	 
 

 

दिया गया है: P × Q ÷ T + Z – S # K

P, Q की पत्नी है, Q, T का पिता है, T, Z की माता है, Z, S का भाई है और S, K की पुत्री है।

इसलिए, K, Q की **पुत्री का पति** है।

अतः, सही उत्तर "**पुत्री का पति**" है।

रोहित बिंदु A से चलना शुरू करता है और पूर्व की ओर 25 किमी गाड़ी चलाता है।

questions.explanation:
The correct answer is **Atmospheric refraction**.

Key Points

	Atmospheric refraction is the bending of light rays as they pass through the Earth's atmosphere, which has varying densities.
	This phenomenon occurs because light travels at different speeds in different layers of the atmosphere.
	As light moves from one layer to another, it changes direction due to the change in its speed.
	Atmospheric refraction is responsible for various optical phenomena such as the twinkling of stars and the apparent position of the sun.
	This bending of light also causes the apparent position of celestial objects to shift from their true position.

**Additional Information**

	**Atmospheric scattering**

	
		This occurs when particles and molecules in the atmosphere scatter light in different directions.
		It is responsible for the blue color of the sky during the day and the red/orange hues during sunrise and sunset.
	
	
	**Atmospheric reflection**
	
		This is the process by which light rays are reflected off the surface of clouds and other atmospheric particles.
		It contributes to phenomena such as the visibility of clouds and the brightness of the sky.
	
	
	**Atmospheric dispersion**
	
		This refers to the spreading of light into its component colors due to varying refractive indices for different wavelengths.
		It is responsible for the formation of rainbows and the separation of light into a spectrum.
questions.explanationHi:

questions.questionText: In what duration will a sum of money double itself at 10% per annum rate of simple interest?
questions.questionTextHi: साधारण ब्याज की 10% वार्षिक दर से एक धनराशि कितने समय में स्वयं की दोगुनी हो जाएगी?
questions.explanation:
**Given:**

Principal (P) = Amount (A) / 2 (as the sum doubles itself)

Rate of Interest (R) = 10% per annum

Time (T) = ?

**Formula used:**

Simple Interest (SI) = (P × R × T) / 100

When the sum doubles, Amount (A) = Principal (P) + SI

⇒ SI = P

**Calculation:**

SI = P

⇒ P = (P × R × T) / 100

⇒ 1 = (R × T) / 100

⇒ T = 100 / R

⇒ T = 100 / 10

⇒ T = 10 years

**∴ The sum of money will double itself in 10 years.**
questions.explanationHi:
**दिया गया है:**

मूलधन (P) = मिश्रधन (A) / 2 (चूँकि धनराशि दोगुनी हो जाती है)

ब्याज दर (R) = 10% प्रति वर्ष

समय (T) = ?

**प्रयुक्त सूत्र:**

साधारण ब्याज (SI) = (P × R × T) / 100

जब धनराशि दोगुनी हो जाती है, मिश्रधन (A) = मूलधन (P) + SI

⇒ SI = P

**गणना:**

SI = P

⇒ P = (P × R × T) / 100

⇒ 1 = (R × T) / 100

⇒ T = 100 / R

⇒ T = 100 / 10

⇒ T = 10 वर्ष

**∴ धनराशि 10 वर्षों में स्वयं की दोगुनी हो जाएगी।**

questions.questionText: What percentage of the numbers from 1 to 70, both included, have 1 or 7 in the unit's digit?
questions.questionTextHi: 1 से 70 तक (दोनों शामिल) की संख्याओं में से कितने प्रतिशत संख्याओं के इकाई अंक में 1 या 7 है?
questions.explanation:
**Given:**

Total numbers = 70 (from 1 to 70, both included)

We need to find numbers with 1 or 7 in the unit's digit.

**Formula used:**

Percentage = (Count of numbers with 1 or 7 in the unit's digit / Total numbers) × 100

**Calculation:**

Numbers with 1 in the unit's digit: 1, 11, 21, 31, 41, 51, 61 (7 numbers)

Numbers with 7 in the unit's digit: 7, 17, 27, 37, 47, 57, 67 (7 numbers)

Total numbers with 1 or 7 in the unit's digit = 7 + 7 = 14

Percentage = (14 / 70) × 100

⇒ Percentage = 20%

**∴ 20% of the numbers from 1 to 70 have 1 or 7 in the unit's digit.**
questions.explanationHi:
**दिया गया है:**

कुल संख्याएँ = 70 (1 से 70 तक, दोनों शामिल)

हमें इकाई अंक में 1 या 7 वाली संख्याएँ ज्ञात करनी हैं।

**प्रयुक्त सूत्र:**

प्रतिशत = (इकाई अंक में 1 या 7 वाली संख्याओं की संख्या / कुल संख्याएँ) × 100

**गणना:**

इकाई अंक में 1 वाली संख्याएँ: 1, 11, 21, 31, 41, 51, 61 (7 संख्याएँ)

इकाई अंक में 7 वाली संख्याएँ: 7, 17, 27, 37, 47, 57, 67 (7 संख्याएँ)

इकाई अंक में 1 या 7 वाली कुल संख्याएँ = 7 + 7 = 14

प्रतिशत = (14 / 70) × 100

⇒ प्रतिशत = 20%

**∴ 1 से 70 तक की संख्याओं में से 20% संख्याओं के इकाई अंक में 1 या 7 है।**

		Emerging Economy Technology Transfer: Facilitating the expedited transfer of innovative solutions to emerging economies, assisting in their transition to more sustainable practices.

questions.questionText: Which of the following lacks membrane?
questions.questionTextHi: निम्नलिखित में से किसमें झिल्ली का अभाव होता है?
questions.explanation:
The correct answer is **Viruses**.

Key Points

	Viruses are acellular entities, meaning they do not have a cellular structure and lack cell membranes.
	They are composed of genetic material (either DNA or RNA) surrounded by a protein coat called a capsid.
	Viruses cannot replicate on their own and must infect a host cell to reproduce.
	They do not possess organelles such as mitochondria, endoplasmic reticulum, or ribosomes, which are found in eukaryotic cells.
	Due to their lack of cellular structure, viruses are considered obligate intracellular parasites.

**Additional Information**

	**Plant Cell**

	
		Plant cells have a cell wall, a large central vacuole, and chloroplasts in addition to the cell membrane.
		These cells are eukaryotic and have membrane-bound organelles.
	
	
	**Fungi Cell**
	
		Fungi cells are also eukaryotic and have a cell wall made of chitin, in addition to a cell membrane and membrane-bound organelles.
	
	
	**Animal Cell**
	
		Animal cells lack a cell wall and chloroplasts but have a cell membrane and various membrane-bound organelles such as mitochondria and the endoplasmic reticulum.

questions.questionText: If a : b = 3 : 2 and b : c = 3 : 2, then a : b : c = ?
questions.questionTextHi: यदि a : b = 3 : 2 और b : c = 3 : 2 है, तो a : b : c = ?
questions.explanation:
**Given:**

a : b = 3 : 2

b : c = 3 : 2

**Formula used:**

To find a : b : c, we equalize the middle term (b) in both ratios.

**Calculation:**

a : b = 3 : 2

b : c = 3 : 2

To equalize b, find the LCM of 2 and 3, which is 6.

For a : b, multiply by 3: (3 × 3) : (2 × 3) = 9 : 6

For b : c, multiply by 2: (3 × 2) : (2 × 2) = 6 : 4

Now combine the ratios: a : b : c = 9 : 6 : 4

**∴ a : b : c = 9 : 6 : 4**
questions.explanationHi:
**दिया गया है:**

a : b = 3 : 2

b : c = 3 : 2

**प्रयुक्त सूत्र:**

a : b : c ज्ञात करने के लिए, हम दोनों अनुपातों में मध्य पद (b) को समान करते हैं।

**गणना:**

a : b = 3 : 2

b : c = 3 : 2

b को समान करने के लिए, 2 और 3 का LCM ज्ञात कीजिए, जो 6 है।

a : b के लिए, 3 से गुणा कीजिए: (3 × 3) : (2 × 3) = 9 : 6

b : c के लिए, 2 से गुणा कीजिए: (3 × 2) : (2 × 2) = 6 : 4

अब अनुपातों को संयोजित करने पर: a : b : c = 9 : 6 : 4

**इसलिए a : b : c = 9 : 6 : 4**

questions.questionText: Which part of the neuron is responsible for acquiring information?
questions.questionTextHi: तंत्रिकोशिका का कौन सा भाग सूचना प्राप्त करने के लिए उत्तरदायी है?
questions.explanation:
The correct answer is **Dendritic tip**.

Key Points

	The **dendritic tip** is the part of the neuron that is responsible for receiving and acquiring information from other neurons or sensory receptors.
	Dendrites are branched extensions of the neuron that conduct electrical signals toward the cell body.
	The tips of dendrites have specialized structures known as **synaptic terminals** that facilitate communication with other neurons.
	Dendrites play a crucial role in **neural connectivity** and the formation of neural networks.
	The structure and branching pattern of dendrites can influence the **strength and integration** of synaptic inputs.

**Additional Information**

	**Axon**

	
		The axon is a long, slender projection of the neuron that conducts electrical impulses away from the cell body towards other neurons or effectors.
		Axons are typically involved in the transmission of information over long distances within the nervous system.
	
	
	**Cell Body**
	
		The cell body, or soma, contains the nucleus and other organelles essential for the neuron's functions.
		It is responsible for maintaining the metabolic activities of the neuron.
	
	
	**Synapse**
	
		The synapse is the junction between two neurons or between a neuron and a target cell, where communication occurs through neurotransmitter release.
		Synaptic transmission is a crucial process for information flow within the nervous system.

questions.questionText: A tree breaks and falls to the ground such that its upper part is still partially attached to its stem. At what height did it break, if the original height of the tree was 24 m and it makes an angle of 30° with the ground?
questions.questionTextHi: एक पेड़ टूटकर जमीन पर गिर जाता है, इस प्रकार इसका ऊपरी भाग अभी भी आंशिक रूप से इसके तने से जुड़ा हुआ है। यह किस ऊँचाई पर टूटा था, यदि पेड़ की मूल ऊँचाई 24 मीटर थी और यह जमीन के साथ 30° का कोण बनाता है?
questions.explanation:
**Given:**

Original height of the tree = 24 m

Angle with the ground = 30°

**Formula Used:**

In a right triangle, if θ is the angle, the length of the side opposite to θ is given by:

Opposite side = Hypotenuse × sin θ 

**Calculation:**

Let the height at which the tree broke be h meters.

After breaking, the upper part forms a right triangle with the ground.

The hypotenuse of this triangle is (24 - h) meters (the length of the broken part).

The opposite side to the angle 30° is h meters (the height from the ground to the break point).

Using the sine formula:

h = (24 - h) × sin(30°)

We know that sin(30°) = 1/2

⇒ h = (24 - h) × 1/2

⇒ 2h = 24 - h

⇒ 2h + h = 24

⇒ 3h = 24

⇒ h = 24 / 3

⇒ h = 8

**The height at which the tree broke is 8 meters.**
questions.explanationHi:
**दिया गया है:**

पेड़ की मूल ऊँचाई = 24 मीटर

जमीन के साथ कोण = 30°

**प्रयुक्त सूत्र:**

एक समकोण त्रिभुज में, यदि θ कोण है, तो θ के विपरीत भुजा की लंबाई दी जाती है:

विपरीत भुजा = कर्ण × sin θ

**गणना:**

मान लीजिए कि जिस ऊँचाई पर पेड़ टूटा है वह h मीटर है।

टूटने के बाद, ऊपरी भाग जमीन के साथ एक समकोण त्रिभुज बनाता है।

इस त्रिभुज का कर्ण (24 - h) मीटर है (टूटे हुए भाग की लंबाई)।

30° कोण के विपरीत भुजा h मीटर है (जमीन से टूटने के बिंदु तक की ऊँचाई)।

ज्या सूत्र का उपयोग करने पर:

h = (24 - h) × sin(30°)

हम जानते हैं कि sin(30°) = 1/2

⇒ h = (24 - h) × 1/2

⇒ 2h = 24 - h

⇒ 2h + h = 24

⇒ 3h = 24

⇒ h = 24 / 3

⇒ h = 8

**वह ऊँचाई जिस पर पेड़ टूटा वह 8 मीटर है।**

questions.explanation:
The correct answer is **upthrust of water on a bottle is greater than the gravitational force acting on the bottle**.

Key Points

	When an empty bottle is pushed underwater, it displaces a volume of water equal to its own volume.
	The water exerts an upward buoyant force on the bottle, known as upthrust.
	Since the bottle is empty (filled with air), its density is much lower than the density of water.
	The upthrust exerted by the water is greater than the gravitational force acting on the empty bottle.
	This difference in forces causes the bottle to bounce back to the surface when it is released.

**Additional Information**

	**Buoyant Force**

	
		It is the upward force exerted by a fluid on an object submerged in it.
		The magnitude of the buoyant force is equal to the weight of the fluid displaced by the object.
	
	
	**Archimedes' Principle**
	
		This principle states that any object submerged in a fluid experiences a buoyant force equal to the weight of the fluid it displaces.
		It explains why objects float or sink in fluids.
	
	
	**Density**
	
		Density is defined as mass per unit volume of a substance.
		Objects with lower density than the fluid they are in will float, while those with higher density will sink.

questions.explanation:
The correct answer is **Four**.

Key Points

	The valency of carbon is **four**.
	Carbon has **four electrons** in its outer shell.
	It needs **four more electrons** to complete its octet, hence its valency is four.
	Carbon forms **four covalent bonds** with other atoms to achieve a stable electronic configuration.
	Common carbon compounds include **methane (CH4)**, where carbon forms four single bonds with hydrogen atoms.

**Additional Information**

	**Carbon Compounds**

	
		Carbon can form a wide variety of compounds due to its ability to form stable covalent bonds with other carbon atoms.
		These compounds can be simple molecules like methane or complex structures like proteins and DNA.
	
	
	**Allotropes of Carbon**
	
		Carbon exists in several allotropes including graphite, diamond, and graphene.
		Each allotrope has distinct physical properties due to differences in the arrangement of carbon atoms.
	
	
	**Organic Chemistry**
	
		The study of carbon compounds is known as organic chemistry.
		It encompasses the study of the structure, properties, and reactions of carbon-containing compounds.

questions.questionText: According to the law of constant proportion, what will be the correct ratio of obtained oxygen and hydrogen (O : H) after decomposition of 18 g water?
questions.questionTextHi: स्थिर अनुपात के नियम के अनुसार, 18 g जल के अपघटन के बाद प्राप्त ऑक्सीजन और हाइड्रोजन (O : H) का सही अनुपात क्या होगा?
questions.explanation:
The correct answer is **16:2**.

Key Points

	According to the law of constant proportion, a chemical compound always contains exactly the same proportion of elements by mass.
	Water (H2O) is composed of hydrogen and oxygen in a fixed ratio of 2:16 by mass.
	The molar mass of water is 18 g/mol, with oxygen contributing 16 g/mol and hydrogen contributing 2 g/mol.
	Upon decomposition of 18 g of water, 16 g of oxygen and 2 g of hydrogen will be obtained.
	This ratio of the mass of oxygen to hydrogen (O:H) after decomposition is 16:2, confirming the law of constant proportion.

**Additional Information**

	**Law of Multiple Proportions**

	
		This law states that if two elements combine to form more than one compound, the masses of one element that combine with a fixed mass of the other are in ratios of small whole numbers.
	
	
	**Law of Conservation of Mass**
	
		This law states that mass is neither created nor destroyed in a chemical reaction.
	
	
	**Law of Definite Composition**
	
		This law states that a chemical compound always contains the same elements in the exact same proportions by mass.

questions.questionText: A sells a bicycle to B at a profit of 20% and B sells it to C at a profit of 25%. If C pays ₹1,500, then what did A pay for it?
questions.questionTextHi: A, B को 20% लाभ पर एक साइकिल बेचता है और B, C को 25% लाभ पर बेचता है। यदि C ₹1,500 का भुगतान करता है, तो A ने इसके लिए कितना भुगतान किया था?
questions.explanation:
**Given:**

Profit by A = 20%

Profit by B = 25%

Final price paid by C = ₹1,500

**Formula used:**

Cost price for B = Selling price of A

Cost price for C = Selling price of B

Selling price = Cost price × (1 + Profit% / 100)

**Calculation:**

Let A's cost price be ₹x.

C's cost price = B's selling price

⇒ 1500 = B's cost price × (1 + 25 / 100)

⇒ 1500 = B's cost price × 1.25

⇒ B's cost price = 1500 / 1.25

⇒ B's cost price = ₹1,200

B's cost price = A's selling price

A's selling price = A's cost price × (1 + 20 / 100)

⇒ 1200 = A's cost price × 1.2

⇒ A's cost price = 1200 / 1.2

⇒ A's cost price = ₹1,000

**∴ A paid ₹1,000 for the bicycle.**

**Alternate Method** Profit by A = 20%

Profit by B = 25%

Final price paid by C = ₹1,500

Let A's cost price be ₹x.

1500 = x × 120/100 × 125/100

x = (1500 × 100 × 100)/(120 × 125)

x = (1500 × 5 × 4)/(6 × 5)

x = (1500 × 2)/3 = 1000

∴ A paid ₹1,000 for the bicycle.

	**Acceleration** is defined as the rate of change of velocity of an object with respect to time.

	Acceleration can be caused by changing the speed of an object, its direction of motion, or both.

**Additional Information**

	**Speed**

	
		Speed is a scalar quantity that refers to how fast an object is moving, regardless of its direction.
		It is calculated as the distance traveled per unit of time.
	
	
	**Velocity**
	
		Velocity is a vector quantity that describes the speed of an object in a specific direction.
		It is calculated as the displacement per unit of time.
	
	
	**Distance**
	
		Distance is a scalar quantity that refers to the total path length covered by an object during its motion.
		It does not take the direction of motion into account.

questions.questionText: Which of the following organisms is/are NOT unicellular?
questions.questionTextHi: निम्नलिखित में से कौन सा/से जीव एककोशिकीय नहीं है/हैं?
questions.explanation:
The correct answer is **Plants**.

Key Points

	Plants are **multicellular organisms**, meaning they are composed of multiple cells that work together to perform various functions.
	Each plant cell has a specific role, contributing to the overall structure and function of the plant.
	Unlike unicellular organisms, plants have specialized cells for different tasks such as photosynthesis, nutrient transport, and reproduction.
	Examples of unicellular organisms include Amoeba, Paramoecium, and Chlamydomonas, which are composed of a single cell that performs all the necessary life functions.
	Multicellular organisms like plants have a higher level of organization and complexity compared to unicellular organisms.

**Additional Information**

	**Amoeba**

	
		Amoeba are unicellular organisms that move and ingest food using pseudopodia, which are temporary projections of the cell.
		They are commonly found in freshwater environments and play a role in nutrient cycling.
	
	
	**Paramoecium**
	
		Paramoecium are unicellular organisms that use cilia for movement and feeding.
		They are often found in aquatic habitats and are known for their slipper-like shape.
	
	
	**Chlamydomonas**
	
		Chlamydomonas are unicellular green algae that have flagella for movement and are capable of photosynthesis.
		They serve as a model organism in biological research due to their simple structure and ease of cultivation.

सही उत्तर **पौधे** है।

Key Points

	पौधे **बहुकोशिकीय जीव** हैं, जिसका अर्थ है कि वे कई कोशिकाओं से बने होते हैं जो विभिन्न कार्यों को करने के लिए एक साथ काम करते हैं।
	प्रत्येक पादप कोशिका की एक विशिष्ट भूमिका होती है, जो पौधे की समग्र संरचना और कार्य में योगदान करती है।
	एककोशिकीय जीवों के विपरीत, पौधों में प्रकाश संश्लेषण, पोषक तत्वों के परिवहन और प्रजनन जैसे विभिन्न कार्यों के लिए विशिष्ट कोशिकाएँ होती हैं।
	एककोशिकीय जीवों के उदाहरणों में अमीबा, पैरामीशियम और क्लैमाइडोमोनास शामिल हैं, जो एकल कोशिका से बने होते हैं जो सभी आवश्यक जीवन कार्य करती है।
	पौधों जैसे बहुकोशिकीय जीवों में एककोशिकीय जीवों की तुलना में उच्च स्तर का संगठन और जटिलता होती है।

**Additional Information**

	**अमीबा**

	
		अमीबा एककोशिकीय जीव हैं जो छद्दपादों का उपयोग करके गति करते हैं और भोजन ग्रहण करते हैं, जो कोशिका के अस्थायी प्रक्षेपण होते हैं।
		वे आमतौर पर अलवण जल के वातावरण में पाए जाते हैं और पोषक तत्वों के चक्रण में भूमिका निभाते हैं।
	
	
	**पैरामीशियम**
	
		पैरामीशियम एककोशिकीय जीव हैं जो गति और भोजन के लिए पक्ष्माभ का उपयोग करते हैं।
		वे अक्सर जलीय आवासों में पाए जाते हैं और अपने चप्पल जैसे आकार के लिए जाने जाते हैं।
	
	
	**क्लेमाइडोमोनास**
	
		क्लेमाइडोमोनास एककोशिकीय हरे शैवाल हैं जिनमें गति के लिए कशाभिका होती है और जो प्रकाश संश्लेषण करने में सक्षम होते हैं।
		वे अपनी सरल संरचना और खेती में आसानी के कारण जैविक अनुसंधान में एक मॉडल जीव के रूप में काम करते हैं।
